# Nina Manova Pilates

> Private and semi-private classical Pilates in Fort Lauderdale, Florida, taught by Nina Manova, a third-generation classical Pilates teacher. Sessions take place in clients' homes, building gyms, the studio or online. Optional Nourishment guidance (general wellness guidance, no meal plans) can be added to any format. Every new client starts with a free 20-minute consultation.

Service area: Coral Ridge, The Landings, Bay Colony, Sea Ranch Lakes and nearby Fort Lauderdale (zip codes 33301, 33304, 33305, 33306, 33308, 33316, 33062, 33064). Online sessions anywhere.
Contact: (754) 999-0699 (call or text), manova.nina@gmail.com. Prices are shared at the consultation.

## Services
- [Classical Pilates](https://ninamanova.com/classical-pilates/): private, semi-private and online sessions on the full apparatus or mat
- [Nourishment](https://ninamanova.com/nourishment/): optional guidance added to Pilates sessions
- [Pilates for Kids & Teens](https://ninamanova.com/kids/): ages 6 to 17; private, siblings or friends, parent and child
- [Book a free consultation](https://ninamanova.com/begin/)
